Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.

WITH album_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.AlbumId,
        SUM(i.UnitPrice * i.Quantity) AS album_total
    FROM invoice_items i
    JOIN tracks t ON i.TrackId = t.TrackId
    GROUP BY t.AlbumId
),
artist_album_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ArtistId,
        SUM(s.album_total) AS artist_total_sales
    FROM album_sales s
    JOIN albums al ON s.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN artists a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT artist_album_sales.ArtistId
    FROM artist_album_sales
    JOIN artists a ON artist_album_sales.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    ORDER BY artist_album_sales.artist_total_sales DESC, a.Name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
    SELECT artist_album_sales.ArtistId
    FROM artist_album_sales
    JOIN artists a ON artist_album_sales.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    ORDER BY artist_album_sales.artist_total_sales ASC, a.Name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        iv.CustomerId,
        al.ArtistId,
        SUM(i.UnitPrice * i.Quantity) AS spending
    FROM invoice_items i
    JOIN tracks t ON i.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN invoices iv ON i.InvoiceId = iv.InvoiceId
    WHERE al.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist UNION SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)
    GROUP BY iv.CustomerId, al.ArtistId
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerId,
        ArtistId,
        SUM(spending) AS total_spending
    FROM customer_spending
    GROUP BY CustomerId, ArtistId
),
artist_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtistId,
        AVG(total_spending) AS avg_spending
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY ArtistId
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist) AS top_artist_id,
    (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist) AS bottom_artist_id,
    (SELECT avg_spending FROM artist_averages WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) AS top_avg,
    (SELECT avg_spending FROM artist_averages WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)) AS bottom_avg,
    ABS(
        (SELECT avg_spending FROM artist_averages WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) -
        (SELECT avg_spending FROM artist_averages WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist))
    ) AS absolute_difference
